mechanism_narrative: The current unemployment rate of 4.4% is below the historical average of 5.0%, indicating a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, the 20d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate of more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in 3 months, the 20d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and the CPI index exceeds 325, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy that reduces risk appetite and suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 325, the 20d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 325), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced real returns and increased risk aversion, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 325, the 20d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1250 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1250, the 5d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (2017=100) indicates a weakening economy and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, the 60d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of strong housing starts (HOUST > 1250) and high retail sales (RSAFS > 735000) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 735000, the 20d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 3.72% is below the 4.0% level, indicating a loose monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, the 5d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.
